files.description: Meta-ADR — Status: approved at Step 03 (commit 715014a) under all four canonical sign-offs; links to ten content ADRs + three autonomous-factory documents. Serves as the sign-off envelope for the ten content ADRs (FR-001..FR-010). Sixth reviewer round 2026-05-29: aligned the Consequences §:109 bullet with the round-5 #2 C8 reframing — replaced the obsolete claim that C8 enumerates the ten ADRs as `stable` consumer-shipped surface with the corrected `internal` normative-reference classification (consumers inherit the architectural baseline via the C7/C8 contract surface and the consumer-overlay parameter mechanism, not via mirroring of the ADR files themselves, which are pruned at consumer init); this also resolves the meta-ADR's internal contradiction between :109 (claimed `stable` mirroring) and :113 (correctly stated 'ADRs are not mirrored per existing convention') (codex P2 round-6 #2).
FR-001 — LLM model router policy (three-tier router). Status: approved from inception under meta-ADR envelope.
FR-002 — Persona-skill contract. Status: approved from inception under meta-ADR envelope.
FR-003 — Trigger authorization model. Status: approved from inception under meta-ADR envelope.
FR-004 — Sovereignty + ZDR posture; cites #339 NFR-SEC-001 verbatim per NFR-SEC-001 (prohibits factory-side egress allowlist content). Status: approved from inception.

FR-005 — Separation of duties at factory velocity; cites #339 NFR-SEC-001 verbatim per NFR-SEC-002 (factory-bot exact-string equality on GitHub login; no substring/regex/display-name heuristics). Status: approved from inception. Amended 2026-05-29 (Step 06 follow-up) with § Satisfaction paths — Path 1 multi-author (default) + Path 2 solo-operator (alternative, gated by `solo_operator: true` in contract.yaml + canonical attestation comment with five-item checklist); Option E (rejected) added; Consequences extended; `sealed` classification preserved (mode-selection from a fixed blueprint-defined path-set is not parameterization). Reviewer-round update 2026-05-29: added a prominent For-#336-implementers callout at the head of § Satisfaction paths so implementers cannot miss the two-code-path requirement (Claude review observation #5).

FR-006 — Reject-rerun cap (cap=2; factory-escalated label semantics). Status: approved from inception. Fourth reviewer round 2026-05-29: the rerun-cap-hit C7 emission was rewritten to use the valid C7 enum value `outcome: rejected` (the rerun trigger is rejected) with `rejection_reason: rerun-cap-exceeded` as a non-required extension field per C7's `additionalProperties: true` allowance (codex P2 round-4 #1); the matching Consequences bullet was updated to reflect the new outcome+reason pair.

FR-007 — Per-ticket wall-clock + cost ceiling (90 min / $15 USD per work item, per child for decomposed parents — Q-1 Option A). Status: approved from inception. Fourth reviewer round 2026-05-29: the ceiling-hit C7 emission was rewritten to use the valid C7 enum value `outcome: human-handoff` (the pause requires human action to clear via `agent-resume`) with `pause_reason: ceiling-hit` as a non-required extension field per C7's `additionalProperties: true` allowance (codex P2 round-4 #2).
FR-008 — Reviewer model heterogeneity (rotation rule; LiteLLM enforcement via #339 C7 read). Status: approved from inception. MDX braces escaped at Slice 8 for docs-build compatibility.

FR-009 — Triage size threshold (4-class table: small / medium / large-decomposable / escalate — Q-2 Option A). Status: approved from inception. Third reviewer round 2026-05-29: the `escalate` routing rule's C7 emission was rewritten to use the valid C7 enum values `phase: intake` + `outcome: human-handoff` (replacing the schema-invalid `outcome: escalate-class-blocked`); the specific blocking reason is now described as an optional extension field per C7's `additionalProperties: true` allowance (codex P2 #4). Fourth reviewer round 2026-05-29: the Consequences C7 row was rewritten to stop storing triage classes in the `outcome` field — triage emissions now carry `outcome: success` (when the classification function runs to completion) with the triage class itself carried as a `triage_class` extension field per C7's `additionalProperties: true` allowance (codex P2 round-4 #4).

FR-010 — Light decomposition policy (boundary types; fan-out <=5; refusal->escalate; parent ## Integration Acceptance Criteria per #339 C4). Status: approved from inception. MDX braces escaped at Slice 8 for docs-build compatibility. Fourth reviewer round 2026-05-29: the bot-tick-block C7 emission was rewritten to use the valid C7 enum value `outcome: rejected` (the bot's tick attempt is rejected) with `rejection_reason: integration-criteria-bot-tick-blocked` as a non-required extension field per C7's `additionalProperties: true` allowance (codex P2 round-4 #3).

FR-012 + FR-013 — Instrumentation plan: primary + guardrail metrics, per-`owner_team` shape, source-of-truth field per metric, durable-bus emission rule (STACKIT Managed RabbitMQ stream queues with Strimzi-Kafka fallback per Q-5), 13-month retention parity with #334 LogMe WORM (Q-4). Reviewer-round update 2026-05-29: named #334 explicitly as the implementation owner of the sidecar emitter, and expanded the #334 reference line to include LogMe WORM at the 13-month SOC 2 retention floor (Claude review observations #2 and #3). Second reviewer round 2026-05-29: re-anchored the primary-metric source-of-truth onto GitHub Issues / PR events (the `agent-ready` `labeled` event + `pr.merged_at`) because the C7 nine-field schema only represents persona-phase emissions and cannot model label/merge events (codex P2 #3); applied the same re-anchor to the two reviewer-wall-time guardrail rows (human sign-off comments are not C7-emitted per design-contracts.md § C7 emission rule); tightened the first-review-rejection-rate row wording to use C7's actual fields (`persona`, `outcome: rejected`, `rerun_round: 0`); corrected the per-`owner_team` derivation line to reference C7's `owner_team` field (not `actor_team`) snapshotted on the first `phase: intake` event. Third reviewer round 2026-05-29: switched RabbitMQ queue type from `quorum` to `stream` (`x-queue-type: stream`) — log-structured offset-addressable storage that natively satisfies C7 Replayability for new-subscriber catch-up (codex P2 #5); rewrote the C7-to-RabbitMQ mapping table accordingly; reclassified LogMe as long-tail forensic audit beyond the bus retention window rather than as the in-bus replay path; corrected the Data Sources C7 row to remove the misleading 'every label application' claim — label applications are GitHub events, not C7 events (codex P2 #6).

FR-014 — Pre-factory baselines: measurement window 2026-04-17->2026-05-28 (commit df7595c), n=100 merged PRs (Q-6 Option A), four baselines (lead time, reviewer wall-time, formal rejection rate transparently NOT MEASURABLE, defect rate proxy), per-`owner_team` breakdown row, calibration trigger declared. Reviewer-round update 2026-05-29: reworded the § Sample-Size Caveats line to make explicit that n=100 is the verified full population of merged PRs in the 41-day window (via `gh pr list --limit 300`), not an API pagination cap (Claude review observation #4). Fifth reviewer round 2026-05-29: corrected the forward-comparable-factory-metric line to use the C7 sealed enum value `outcome: rejected` (it previously used the schema-invalid `outcome: reject`), with an inline note pointing readers at the sealed enum definition in `design-contracts.md` § Contract C7 (codex P2 round-5 #1). Sixth reviewer round 2026-05-29: fixed the SECOND occurrence of `outcome: reject` in the § Calibration Trigger (§:105) — round-5 #1 only corrected the §:57 instance; same C7 sealed-enum spelling correction (now `outcome: rejected`) with the same inline note pointing readers at the sealed enum definition `success | rejected | retried | human-handoff` in `design-contracts.md` § Contract C7 (codex P2 round-6 #1).

FR-015 — Triage + decomposition data feed: 100-row machine-readable Markdown table with `### Sample Size` subsection per Q-7 Option A; retrospective-hypothetical caveat present; consumed by #338 as directional evidence.

FR-011 — Two-layer routing per CODEOWNERS last-match-wins semantics: gate-1 sign-off teams (@sbonoc/factory-{product,architecture,security,operations}) + gate-2 bounded-context teams (@sbonoc/factory-context-{factory,infra,docs,governance}); Q-3 Option A. Zero `@your-org/...` placeholders; AGENTS.md ownership preserved by tail-block re-anchor. Reviewer-round update 2026-05-29: appended an additional tail-block re-anchor (broad-to-narrow ordering) for `/docs/blueprint/architecture/**`, `/.agents/**`, `/docs/blueprint/autonomous-factory/**`, the ADR-issue-33* glob, and the four new autonomous-factory deliverables — defeats the line-118 `/docs/blueprint/**` docs catch-all so the specialized owners actually win per last-match-wins (codex P1 + P2 inline comments).
